Oh no, I'm so sorry, that must be really scary! Let's take this one step at a time. 💚

**Please contact your vet or a pet poison control service right now.** Don't wait for symptoms to appear. Tell them:
- Your cat chewed a leaf of a **pothos**
- Roughly how much was eaten, and when
- Any symptoms you notice, such as drooling, pawing at the mouth, vomiting, or not wanting to eat

If you can, take a photo of the plant or keep the care card handy so you can describe it accurately.

**What happens next on our side:** I'm escalating this to a Support Lead now, since it involves a pet's safety. They will follow up with you using the email on your account (rvshankar45@gmail.com). Please don't let that delay calling your vet. That call is the most important step.

I don't have specific details in our knowledge base about how a pothos affects cats, so your vet or poison control is the right source for guidance on what to expect and what to do.

Wishing your kitty a quick and smooth recovery. Please reach out any time if you need anything else from us. 🌿
